'''Hallyn''' was a [[city]] on the [[planet]] of [[Alderaan]]. It was the hometown of [[Duke]] [[Kayo Organa]], who lived there with his [[Marriage|wife]], Duchess [[Celly Organa]], and son, [[Niano Organa]].<ref name="SDCC 2023 panel" />
